summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing routine on-market purchases of its own shares under a buyback programme announced 6 January 2026 and conducted through JP Morgan Securities plc. Between 17–21 August 2026, Prudential repurchased 1,886,615 ordinary shares at prices ranging from £10.0250 to £10.5400 per share, with a volume-weighted average price of £10.2857 for the week. The shares will be cancelled, reducing issued capital. As of 21 August 2026, the aggregate buyback total was 56,858,853 shares at an average of £10.8521 per share. The repurchases were executed on the London Stock Exchange and comply with UK Listing Rules and the Hong Kong Code on Share Buy-Backs. The company intends to cancel repurchased shares. Investors should monitor the pace of future buybacks and share count reductions.
